title: HeldJobStall
description: A held job that showed no activity for `heldJobStallMs` (contract/WORKER-CONTRACT.md V2): what a worker's claims say on `stalled`. What its host does then is the host's.

heldSince.description: When the worker was handed the job.

lastActivityAt.description: When the job last showed activity: its claim, a progress report, a checkpoint or a commit.

silentForMs.description: How long it has shown none, in milliseconds.

thresholdMs.description: The `heldJobStallMs` it was held to, in milliseconds.
